title: 第五十七章 书友暴力出场第五十六章 收服哈克龙母子
content_zh:
夜晚，吃过饭后，林萧缩在帐篷中拟定迷你龙和可达鸭的训练计划，特别是迷你龙这个要强的小家伙需要特别对待。
就在林萧忙得天昏地暗的时候，娜姿的帐篷突然传出“啊！！”的一声惨叫，吓得林萧一个抖索，差点让手里的烟戳到脸上，而且惨叫声似乎是男声，娜姿的帐篷里怎么会有男人？
合上笔记本，林萧冲出帐篷。
刚出帐篷就看一个紫色头发，二十来岁的男子和他小精灵沙奈朵在娜姿的念力下和大地来了次亲密接触，虽然沙奈朵已经尽力抵抗，可没有起到任何作用，超能女王让它知道了超能力应该怎么使用。
自从在浅红道馆小树林方便的时候被啊桔的妹妹绫子用飞镖偷袭了一下，娜姿在野外都格外警惕，特别是睡觉、方便的时候。
“救命啊~~不要了，我知道错了，我只是让沙奈朵用瞬间移动，我并不知道会出现在你的帐篷里，女侠饶命啊！！！”和大地亲密接触，吃下无数泥土的男子，趴在地上大声求饶。
使用瞬间移动瞬间出现在娜姿的帐篷里？林萧为这位仁兄默哀，希望他最好赶上娜姿还在和芽衣聊天，而不是穿着小睡衣准备睡觉，否则只能更加悲惨。
“哼！！”娜姿鼻腔中发出一声冷哼，鼓着冰山脸从帐篷里走出，身后还跟着捂住偷笑的芽衣，看两人的衣着应该还没有睡下。
看到娜姿板着脸走出来，紫发男子瞳孔猛缩，身子微微颤抖，使劲朝后缩了几步。不过这位仁兄的运气不错，娜姿没有在第一时间将他变成娃娃，和林萧二人旅行了一段时间，娜姿的性格和善了很多，没有以前那种动不动就超能力伺候或是一声不吭的让你变成可爱的装饰品的行为。
还在用念力抵抗的沙奈朵让娜姿的脸上更加冰冷，林萧连忙插到这两人一宠之间，劝说道：“娜姿，停下吧，别人也不是故意的。让他解释一下好吗？”
“对对！我不是故意的，请你听我解释！”看到林萧出声帮助自己，紫发男子连忙跟着说道。
林萧出生劝解，娜姿收回超能力，轻哼一声，抱起拉鲁拉丝钻进帐篷，显然不想参与接下来的事。芽衣眯着笑眼，朝林萧打了个手势，跟进帐篷，陪娜姿去了。
掏出一根烟递给紫发男子，林萧问道：“说吧，怎么回事？”说完瞄了娜姿的帐篷一眼，“我们说的话她都能听到哦~”
紫发男子还未从紧张状态脱离出来，对林萧说了声谢谢，接过烟点起来，颤抖的手指夹着香烟狠狠的抽了几口，说道：“谢谢你的帮助，我叫暴力，来自神奥，是一位小精灵研究员，因为事情紧迫，所以沙奈朵的瞬间移动没有确定好位子才会出现这种情况，给你们带来麻烦我深感抱歉。”说完对林萧微微鞠躬，掏出自己的研究员资料卡给林萧看。
额.....没确定位子就敢用瞬间移动？你不怕你出现的地方是万丈深渊？或是大针蜂的老窝里？
确实是联盟颁发的研究员资料卡，林萧接过微微看了几眼，还给暴力，说道：“收起你的沙奈朵，到我的帐篷里休息一下。看你的样子好像还没有吃饭，我为你准备点食物吧。”
“谢谢.....你是一个好人.....”暴力收起沙奈朵，再次对林萧鞠躬感谢。不过却没有进林萧的帐篷，知道此时两人还是陌生人，随便进入别人帐篷会显得很没有礼貌。
用剩下的饭，加上两个鸡蛋、一根火腿肠给暴力做了碗炒饭。
“唔~~太好吃了，”暴力嘴里包满饭粒，模糊不清的称赞道：“这还是我吃过最好吃的一次炒饭.......咳咳！！！”
林萧无语的将水递给他，难道没有人教他吃炒饭的时候最好别说话，不然很容易被呛到，再说人在肚子饿的时候吃什么都感觉美味无比。

吃好饭后，两人就这样坐在草地上有一句没一句的聊着。
“暴力，你不是神奥地区的研究员吗？怎么会到关东来了？”而且看你的衣着也不像是来做研究的，林萧在心里默默的加上一句。此时的暴力穿着一身白色西装，系着粉红色蝴蝶结领带，白色的皮鞋，不过因为刚才娜姿的那两下让白色西服和皮鞋沾满了泥巴。
暴力的着装让林萧感觉他更像一位新郎官，而不是前来关东做研究的研究员。
察觉到林萧怪异的眼神，暴力自嘲的一笑，“我的样子很戳吧，其实我是和新婚中的妻子来到关东度蜜月的。”
度蜜月？林萧两眼瞪得老大，度蜜月度到这荒郊野外来了？而且暴力的样子感觉更新逃婚的男人。
“还有烟吗？”
“有.....”林萧掏出烟，递了过去。
暴力沮丧的狠狠抽了几口闷烟，苦笑道：“你知道吗？那一年她十八，我也十八，我们因为研究拉鲁拉丝而相遇。”
“我能感觉到这是上天的安排，我们俩很快成了令无数人羡慕的情侣，一切多么浪漫，多么的美好。今年我们成婚了，举行了一场盛大的婚礼。”
说道这里，暴力捏紧拳头狠狠的在草地上砸了几下，带着哭腔大喊：“可你知道吗？在新婚夜里我美妙的妻子像我索要了八次！！！整整八次！！人生有多少个八次？”
林萧狠狠的咽了咽唾液，忍不住问道：“然后你的妻子每天都缠着你来八次？”想到这里，林萧忍不住打了个冷颤，尼玛这也太强大了，每天都这样的话会死人的......
“你怎么知道的？”暴力带着惊愕的神情问道，随后点点头，“整整半个月，原本美好的蜜月期间，变成了我的地狱之旅，于是.....我带着我的沙奈朵逃跑了......”
林萧错愕的张着大嘴，拍拍暴力的肩膀，实在不知道该怎么安慰他，不过能让他的娇妻每天八次的索要下坚持半个月，已经很伟大了。
“谢谢你，兄弟，倾诉一番，我的心里舒坦不少，不过我需要离开了。”暴力拍拍林萧的肩膀感慨道：“我的妻子会很快追到这里来的，有缘再见，我能闻到你身上有班吉拉的味道，希望下次见面的时候我们能用班吉拉来一次对战。”
在林萧错愕的眼神下，沙奈朵使用瞬间移动带着暴力离开了，留下的只有满地的烟头和地上的空碗。
帐篷中，娜姿红着小脸，使劲挠芽衣的痒痒，鼓着包子脸，“我就说不要听，他们男人在一起能说出什么好话？”
“哈哈.....娜姿姐饶命啊！！是你自己用超能力偷听啊，我只是顺带的而已。哈哈.....饶命.....我不敢了..”芽衣在铺盖上打滚躲避娜姿的袭击。
暴力的妻子果然如他所说，在他离开不到十分钟后就来到林萧三人露宿的地方，可对方温柔大方像个居家小媳妇的模样，怎么想也和暴力所说的一夜八次郎扯上关系。

content_en:
At night, after dinner, Lin Xiao huddled in the tent to formulate a training plan for the Mini Dragon and the Kodak Duck. Especially the stronger little guy, the Mini Dragon, needed special treatment.
Just when Lin Xiao was so busy that the sky was dark, a scream of "Ah!!" suddenly came from Nazi's tent. Lin Xiao was so frightened that he trembled and almost had the cigarette in his hand poked his face. Moreover, the scream seemed to be a male voice. How could there be a man in Nazi's tent?
Closing the notebook, Lin Xiao rushed out of the tent.
As soon as they left the tent, they saw a purple-haired man in his twenties and his elf Gardevoir, who had a close contact with the earth under Nazi's telekinesis. Although Gardevoir tried his best to resist, it had no effect. The Super Queen made it known how to use super powers.
Ever since she was sneak-attacked by Ah Ju's younger sister Ayako with a dart while taking a walk in the grove of the light red gym, Nazhi has been extra vigilant in the wild, especially when sleeping or taking a walk.
"Help~~ No, I know I was wrong. I just asked Gardevoir to teleport. I didn't know that I would appear in your tent. Heroine, please forgive me!!!" The man, who had been in close contact with the earth and had eaten countless amounts of dirt, lay on the ground and begged loudly for mercy.
Use teleportation to instantly appear in Nazi's tent? Lin Xiao mourned for this dear man and hoped that it would be better for him to catch up with Nazhi still chatting with Mei Yi instead of wearing pajamas and getting ready to go to bed, otherwise it would only be more miserable.
"Hmph!!" Nazi snorted coldly in her nose, and walked out of the tent with a swollen face, followed by Mei Yi who covered her snickering. Judging from their clothes, they must have not gone to bed yet.
Seeing Nazi walking out with a straight face, the purple-haired man's pupils shrank sharply, his body trembled slightly, and he took a few steps back. However, this dear friend was very lucky. Nazi didn't turn him into a doll right away. After traveling with Lin Xiao for a while, Nazi's personality became much kinder. She didn't have the behavior like before where she would always serve you with super powers or silently turn you into a cute decoration.
Gardevoir, who was still resisting with telekinesis, made Nazi's face even colder. Lin Xiao quickly intervened between the two of them and persuaded: "Nazi, stop, others didn't mean it. Let him explain, okay?"
"That's right! I didn't mean it, please listen to my explanation!" Seeing Lin Xiao speaking out to help him, the purple-haired man quickly followed.
After Lin Xiaosheng tried to persuade her, Nazhi took back her superpower, snorted softly, picked up La Lulas and got into the tent, obviously not wanting to participate in what happened next. Yayi narrowed her eyes with a smile, gestured to Lin Xiao, and followed Nazhi to the tent.
Taking out a cigarette and handing it to the purple-haired man, Lin Xiao asked, "Tell me, what's going on?" After speaking, he glanced at Nazi's tent, "She can hear everything we say~"
The purple-haired man had not yet come out of his nervous state. He said thank you to Lin Xiao, took the cigarette and lit it. He took a few puffs of the cigarette with trembling fingers and said: "Thank you for your help. My name is Violence. I come from Sinnoh. I am an elf researcher. Because of the urgency of the matter, this situation occurred because Gardevoir's teleportation did not determine the position. I am deeply sorry for causing you trouble." After saying that, he bowed slightly to Lin Xiao and took out his researcher information card to show Lin Xiao.
Um... How dare you use teleportation without confirming your location? Aren't you afraid that the place where you appear is an abyss? Or in the nest of the giant needle wasp?
It was indeed a researcher information card issued by the alliance. Lin Xiao took it and looked at it for a few times, then gave it a violent look and said: "Put away your Gardevoir and go to my tent to take a rest. You look like you haven't eaten yet, so I'll prepare some food for you."
"Thank you... you are a good person..." Violent put away Gardevoir and bowed to Lin Xiao again to thank him. However, he did not enter Lin Xiao's tent. Knowing that the two of them were still strangers at this time, he entered casually.It would be rude to use someone else's tent.
He used the leftover rice, added two eggs and a piece of ham to make a bowl of fried rice for Violence.
"Oh~~it's so delicious," Violent said with a mouth full of rice grains, vaguely praising: "This is the best fried rice I've ever tasted...ahem!!!"
Lin Xiao handed him the water speechlessly. Didn't anyone teach him that it's better not to talk when eating fried rice, otherwise he will easily choke. Besides, everything tastes delicious when you are hungry.
After eating, the two of them sat on the grass and chatted wordlessly.
"Violent, aren't you a researcher from the Sinnoh region? Why did you come to Kanto?" And it doesn't look like you are here for research, Lin Xiao added silently in his heart. At this time, Violent was wearing a white suit, a pink bow tie, and white leather shoes. However, because of Nazi's two blows just now, the white suit and leather shoes were stained with mud.
The violent attire made Lin Xiao feel more like a groom than a researcher who came to Kanto to do research.
Sensing Lin Xiao's weird eyes, he smiled violently and laughed at himself, "I look very funny, but actually I came to Kanto for our honeymoon with my newlywed wife."
Honeymoon? Lin Xiao's eyes widened. Did he come to this wilderness for his honeymoon? And the violent appearance feels newer to a man who ran away from marriage.
"Are there any more cigarettes?"
"Yes..." Lin Xiao took out the cigarette and handed it over.
Violently frustrated, he took a few puffs of his cigarette and said with a wry smile: "Did you know? She was eighteen that year, and so was I. We met because we were studying La Lulas."
"I can feel that this is God's arrangement. The two of us quickly became a couple that was envied by countless people. Everything was so romantic and beautiful. We got married this year and held a grand wedding."
Having said this, he violently clenched his fist and smashed it on the grass a few times, shouting with a cry: "But do you know? On the wedding night, my wonderful wife asked for me eight times!!! A full eight times!! How many eight times are there in life?"
Lin Xiao swallowed hard and couldn't help but ask: "And your wife pestered you eight times a day?" Thinking of this, Lin Xiao couldn't help but shudder. Damn, this is too powerful. If you do this every day, you will die...
"How do you know?" Violent asked with an astonished look, and then nodded, "For half a month, the originally beautiful honeymoon period turned into my journey to hell, so... I ran away with my Gardevoir..."
Lin Xiao opened his mouth in astonishment and patted Violent's shoulder. He really didn't know how to comfort him, but it was already great to be able to persist with his beloved wife asking for eight times a day for half a month.
"Thank you, brother, for talking about it. I feel a lot more comfortable, but I need to leave." Violent patted Lin Xiao on the shoulder and said with emotion: "My wife will catch up here soon. See you again. I can smell the smell of Bangela on you. I hope we can have a battle with Bangela next time we meet."
Under Lin Xiao's stunned eyes, Gardevoir used teleportation and violently left, leaving only cigarette butts on the ground and an empty bowl on the ground.
In the tent, Nazhi's face was red, and she was tickling Mei Yi hard, with a puffy face, "I told you not to listen, what good things can these men say when they are together?"
"Haha... Sister Nazi, please forgive me!! It was you who used your superpower to eavesdrop, I was just passing by. Haha... Forgive me... I don't dare anymore..." Mei rolled on the bed to avoid Nazi's attack.
The violent wife did as he said. Less than ten minutes after he left, she came to the place where Lin Xiao and the other three were sleeping. But she was gentle and generous, like a housewife. No matter what you thought, sheIt has something to do with the violently said Ichiyo Yajiro.
